profile.Name: Hill Marauder King
profile.Personality: Little is known of him. His wanted poster calls him the Mad King.
profile.Backstory: He made himself king of the Hill Marauders, veteran Dust Bandits who broke away to raid on richer and fairer terms and soon fell in line behind him. From the Hill Marauder King Tower he rules the lawless edges of the eastern Border Zone and western Skinner's Roam, and he is wanted for fear he has the men to besiege Bad Teeth.
profile.SpeechQuirks: No speech of his own is recorded.
